data.body:
Landed at review. PR #5: https://github.com/mrojas54/tool-benchmarks/pull/5
(base main, head tb-5-passive; body notes it assembles TB-3/#3 + TB-4/#2 via
integration/substrate and should merge after those).

Delivered: toolbench/passive.py (incremental Reducer + argparse CLI +
four-section report + S23 exit contract) replacing the TB-2 stub, plus
tests/test_passive.py (39 new tests). Full suite: 79/79 green. ruff clean.
mypy --strict clean over toolbench + tests. `uv run python -m
toolbench.passive --help` smoke passes.

S11 no-corpus-list invariant confirmed both by design (Reducer/AgentStats/
ToolStats/InefficiencyCounters hold only scalar/dict aggregates, never a
list[ToolCall]) and by a structural test that introspects
dataclasses.fields() to assert no field is ever typed with ToolCall — this
fails loudly if a future change reintroduces a corpus-wide list.

Deviations (all documented in the plan file and the own-review artifact):
1. AgentsView-sourced sessions (SessionRef.path=None) are bridged into
   parse_session via a temp file (transcript.py has no "parse from lines"
   entry point, and it/sources.py were left untouched per the guardrails).
2. main()/_discover_refs() accept a `root` kwarg for hermetic testing
   (tmp roots); it is not a CLI flag since S12's flag list has none.
3. Subagent fan-out detection uses a heuristic tool-name set
   ({"Agent","Task"}) — no SPEC-given canonical name.
4. `--agent` filtering is a no-op under `--index-source raw` because
   sources._raw_session_refs doesn't accept an agent param at all
   (pre-existing behavior in sources.py, out of scope here).

Own-reviewer verdict: APPROVE, no Critical/Major findings (see attached
review artifact). Validation outputs attached separately. Not merging —
leaving at review per the workflow contract.

PR #5 (tb-5-passive) merged to main as 4e4b1c2 at 2026-07-09T01:01:31Z. passive.py reducer + report + CLI landed; adds tools_by_model (agent x model x tool) and the Model Breakdown section (S14, five sections). Verified on origin/main @4461c0e: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (10 source files), 99 tests pass. Remote branch pruned post-merge.
